user.title: Monitor power outages
user.description:
Choose how to match planned outages:
- **Parcel number:** enter the town/district and one HRSZ, for example `0123/4`. Street and house number can be blank. Leave postcode blank if you do not want an extra postal filter.
- **Street address:** use the street name listed by E.ON and a house number such as `14` or `14/A`. Omit floor, door and apartment details.
- **Town/district:** leave postcode, street, house number and parcel number blank to see all reports for that town.

Enter `Budapest` to include every district. To narrow the area, `Budapest XVI.`, `Budapest 16` and `Budapest 16. kerület` all work. Town names also include published district/locality suffixes. If both parcel and address are entered, published parcel identifiers take priority; the address is a fallback when no parcel is published.

Enable **Include nearby reports** and select a map point and radius to see additional geographic candidates (maximum 100 km). This circle is independent of the address and is not filled automatically from it. Nearby reports and town-level faults do not confirm your property is affected. Your address and map circle stay local.

data_description.city: Budapest includes every district. Optionally narrow it with Budapest XVI. or Budapest 16. kerület. Accents and punctuation are ignored.
data_description.postcode: Optional four-digit filter. Leave blank for parcel-only matching if postal data is inconsistent.
data_description.street: E.ON street name, including utca/út. Leave blank for parcel-only matching.
data_description.house_number: House number only, for example 14/A; no floor, door or apartment.
data_description.parcel_number: One exact HRSZ, for example 0123/4 or 538/B. Keep leading zeros and all slash components.
data_description.nearby_enabled: Adds separate nearby sensors and a calendar. Choose a point and radius below.
data_description.location: Centre the circle on the property and choose your radius. This does not change address or parcel matching.
